question: Does the already frozen non-GC TA representation contain linearly accessible S-side information for M5 and the other four timeframes that the native side decoder fails to use?
hypothesis: A per-TF pre-pooling representation may retain S direction information lost or inaccessible at the shared hidden/native decoder boundary. This is a representation-accessibility diagnostic, not a new Entry model or Edge test.

reused_method.solver: existing regularized Newton logistic readout and frozen coordinate owner; no hyperparameter search

preflight_before_any_fit: Fresh one-use policy admission, source/script hash, exact capture SHA and TRAIN/LATER axis/target parity.
Prove the S masks and all five TF labels are present in both immutable archives.
No model construction, model forward, checkpoint read or target regeneration.
locked_scoring: Each TF uses the same eligible-and-mature allowed{1,4} TRAIN side mask for its two linear arms and its frozen TRAIN prior.

Freeze all coordinates, coefficients and priors before opening LATER. Score conditional S-side Brier, log loss and AUC for every TF on the same later known-side rows; compare against native and prior.
Primary M5: report later S-side Brier/AUC and prospective native five-minute turn AUC/Brier on the certified paired subset, with current side reconstructed only for retrospective scoring.

Report actual DOWN/FLAT/UP decisions by combining each readout side probability with the same frozen native activity probability; count FLAT and correct distinct TF directions on joint-certified conflicts.
Use the prior fixed UTC-day/Monday-week paired bootstrap method and report all five TF without selecting a favorable TF, month, checkpoint or threshold.
interpretation_gate: A PREPOOL gain would support accessible S information before pooling under this fixed linear method; it would not prove pooling is the only cause or qualify Edge.
A SHARED gain over NATIVE would support decoder insufficiency under this fixed method; a lack of gain would not prove no nonlinear information exists.
If M5 still fails frozen prior or turn discrimination, stop this decoder route; do not launch a broad architecture or epoch search from this result.
Any favorable result remains reused development and requires separate independent chronological qualification, full M5 Entry evaluation and economic evidence before Edge.
